i.norm: Verifies that getCumFreq returns 0 for a value that was never added with a positive count. One value is incremented by 0 and another by -1, so the frequency table holds no positive observations. Querying the cumulative frequency of an unrelated value (0) must therefore yield 0.
Increment two values by non-positive amounts: neither adds a real observation.
Cumulative frequency of an unrelated, unrecorded value should be 0.
